description: Early voting begins Monday in the special election for Texas’ 145th House District and will continue through January 25 at five Harris County polling sites, leading up to Election Day on January 29.The five early voting locations, all in Houston, are:1. The conference center of the Harris County Law Library, 1019 Congress Ave.2. Moody Park Community Center, 3725 Fulton St.3. Ripley House Neighborhood Center, 4410 Navigation Blvd.4.
